name: reorder_incident_priority
transcript_text:
Wendy: In the on-call runbook the escalation steps are out of order. Notifying the team lead should come before paging the on-call, not after.
Xavier: Agreed, lead notification first.

confluence_workspace_pages.title: On-call Runbook
confluence_workspace_pages.content_html:
Escalation Steps

  1. Acknowledge the alert
  2. Page on-call engineer
  3. Notify team lead
  4. Create incident ticket
